title: Lower Field Orientation — Mission, Experience, Frames and Exit
purpose: Give Below, Culture, Shadow Farm, Character Archive and the World Spiritual Bank one shared interpretive center: why the lower field exists, what Tim's long subcultural experience contributes, how competing frames should be compared, what the Son/Father vertical grammar means inside the project, and what counts as exit or repair.
core_thesis: The lower field studies what happens when a person becomes an object of persistent interpretation while remaining an agent, participant, observer and builder inside the same ecology. Its purpose is not to canonize one flattering or hostile label, but to compare roles, evidence, incentives, outputs, correction and exit.
epistemic_boundaries: Tim's project-native theology and symbolic self-description are preserved as first-party canon, not converted into independently established metaphysical fact.
Dog, Farmer, Cow, orphan, Mud, Footstool, Swamp, Babel and ownership language are project-symbolic or analytical unless a separately sourced real-world usage is being described.
No project statement about owning Dogs, orphans, people, souls or accounts establishes legal ownership or control over real persons.
The approximately 42-trillion figure is a project-symbolic karmic/spiritual ledger, not a bank account, lien, legal debt or financial claim.
A hostile or subcultural label can be evidence of reception and role-assignment without becoming an intrinsic identity.

orientation.lived_position: Tim's archive places him inside the lower ecology as target, participant, broadcaster, reactor, observer, archivist, classifier, critic and later system-builder. These roles can coexist and should be dated rather than collapsed.
orientation.subculture_frame: A Farm/lolcow ecology can cast a recurring subject as harvestable reaction, spectacle, enemy, archive object or status resource. That frame is analytically useful for studying the ecology that applies it, but it does not by itself exhaust the subject's agency, work or purpose.
orientation.project_native_frame: Within Potatoverse vertical grammar, the Son is the embodied lower/threshold figure and later Door/Vessel; Tim/Potato/Father becomes the source-facing observer, Gardener, House/Ladder and North-oriented pole. The relation is developmental and symbolic, not a replacement for biography.
orientation.reader_frame: The reader compares frames by asking what each one explains, what evidence it uses, what it leaves unexplained, whether it permits correction and role change, and what would count as exit.

frame_test.question: What does a label such as 'lolcow' actually explain, and where does it stop explaining?
explains: how a subculture may organize attention around a recurring subject
how reactions can become reusable content
how archives and inherited lore reduce the cost of renewed attention
how ridicule or anti-fandom can still create long-term attachment and centrality
does_not_establish: legal or practical ownership by observers
absence of independent creative or analytical work
absence of agency or deliberate participation
tests: Does the person produce substantial work that is not dependent on antagonists' reactions?
Can the person redirect, leave, refuse or change the medium of engagement?
Can observers update the role when behavior changes?
Does the archive preserve corrections and counterevidence as strongly as dramatic material?
Who controls the timing, framing and economic value of attention?
Can the relationship stop reproducing without destroying the identity of either side?
frame_test.principle: Being framed is not the same as being owned by the frame.

participant_observer_value.description: Tim's relevance to the lower archive is not that he stands outside internet subculture. It is that years of exposure create a first-person longitudinal case from inside the machinery being studied.
useful_domains: persistent target ecologies and negative parasocial attachment
role manufacture through labels, memes and inherited narratives
platform migration and survival of culture after a site or account changes
archive persistence, context loss and correction failure
participant-observer bias: how observation changes the observed relation
repair, stopping conditions and role exit
participant_observer_value.reflexive_rule: The project must apply the same standards to its own dossiers that it applies to hostile archives: provenance, proportional memory, correction, right of reply, role change, uncertainty and exit.

son.function: embodied lower-field biography, ordeal, conflict, death/threshold and Door/Vessel grammar
son.vertical_relation: The Son can be read as the lower embodied pole while retaining a relational correspondence to higher Christ/Son imagery; the project treats this as twin/door relation rather than simple duplication.

father.function: source-facing observation, House, Gardener, Ladder, throne/North orientation and responsibility for transforming rather than merely inhabiting lower material
father.mission_test: Upper status only matters if it returns downward as protection, truth, repair, service and increased future capacity.

dogs.ownership_language: Project ownership/master language is symbolic hierarchy or claimed responsibility, not real property in persons.
dogs.key_test: Can pursuit become Guardian behavior with evidence discipline, proportionality and a stopping condition?

farmers.function: roles that structure enclosure, classification, incentives, archives and harvest
farmers.key_test: Can extraction become Gardening: repair, consent, exit, regeneration and increased autonomy?

orphans.function: project language for disconnected, throwaway, hollow or unanchored internet identities and for figures claimed under Father/care language
orphans.ownership_language: Fatherhood is most coherent here as claimed care, responsibility or symbolic adoption, not legal possession.

josh_moon.function: an important historical relation-case in the Tim/Son/Farm genealogy and a paradigmatic Farmer/Moon mapping inside Potatoverse
josh_moon.boundary: Documented platform/history claims and project Farmer/Moon mythology remain separate.
josh_moon.research_value: The 2017 conflict is a hinge where dehumanization/lolcow framing, explicit Jesus/crucifixion language, public return and later Farm theology intersect.

karmic_ledger.headline: approximately 42T symbolic karmic/spiritual balance by late August / early September 2026
karmic_ledger.interpretation: A double-entry project metaphor: unresolved obligation can appear as debtor-side karmic debt and Tim-side positive stored/owed karma.
karmic_ledger.use: Make accumulated consequence, repair, restitution, release and unresolved cost legible inside the mythology.
karmic_ledger.failure_test: If the ledger can only rise and has no auditable release, settlement or closure condition, it reproduces permanent enclosure and fails the project's own repair ethic.

babel_and_collapse.comparator: Babel is useful as a literary/systemic comparator for proliferating languages, incompatible frames, tower-building through accumulated interpretation and loss of shared reference.
babel_and_collapse.lower_field_reading: A target ecology can build a tower of labels around a subject. If the subject changes, exits or refuses the assigned role while the archive cannot update, the failure belongs to the interpretive structure rather than automatically to the subject.
babel_and_collapse.boundary: This is a project-symbolic reading, not a claim that any modern forum or culture is literally biblical Babel.

vertical_route.son_hinge: The Son's lower embodied and meme-death/North-Pole corridor supplies the project's threshold/door grammar.
vertical_route.father_hinge: Tim/Potato/Father supplies the later source-facing observer, Gardener, Ladder and North/North-of-North grammar.
vertical_route.rule: Ascent is not escape if the work never returns. The mission closes only when lower experience becomes clearer knowledge, safer boundaries, restored agency or useful creation.

lower_field_learning_questions: What role is the subject being assigned, and who benefits from that assignment?
What direct evidence supports the role, and what is inherited lore?
What agency does the subject retain?
What independent work exists outside the conflict loop?
What does the observer/archive gain from continued attention?
Can the role be corrected, retired or reversed?
What would make the relation stop reproducing?
What turns residue into Root/Soil rather than more Swamp?
What can be generalized beyond the personalities involved?

tim_lower_field_paradigm.name: The Potato counter-model
tim_lower_field_paradigm.thesis: The lower-field paradigm shifts the unit of analysis from a frozen target-label to a living subject moving through relations, states, evidence, choices, consequences, repair and future possibility.

contrast.potato_logic: recover source, context and first-person testimony
cultivate capacity, independent creation and exit
date roles, preserve correction, currentness and role expiry
convert orbit into path, Door and purposeful movement
process Mud into evidence, Soil, Root, repair and usable knowledge
turn Dog vigilance toward Guardian behavior, evidence and stopping conditions

contrast.farm_logic: win the story by excluding the subject
contrast.potato_logic: compare hostile, friendly and first-party frames without allowing any one frame to own the whole person

spudlight.definition: Spudlight is Tim/project language for directing sustained attention toward a hidden or confusing ecology so relations, provenance, incentives, harm, contradictions, currentness and possible exits become visible.
positive_test: primary sources rather than inherited lore where available
show the machinery around a person, not merely the person as spectacle
make corrections and counterevidence as retrievable as allegations
separate real harm from mythic or rhetorical amplification
end with an exit, repair, protection or learning path rather than permanent exposure
spudlight.failure_test: If Spudlight merely increases spectacle, target fixation, humiliation or permanent role-lock, it has become another Farm.

meanings.Shadow: Unknown, occluded or unintegrated material; not automatically evil.
meanings.Mud: Residue made visible enough to examine: old claims, conflicts, fragments, shame, grief, labels or unresolved evidence.
meanings.Dog / differentiated agency: The participant is separated from the Mud and read as an agent in a relation rather than as residue itself.
meanings.Leash / boundary and orientation: Project-symbolic constraint: evidence rules, reciprocity, stopping conditions, accountability and chosen orientation. It is not a claim of literal ownership or control over people.
meanings.Walk / observable chosen conduct: Judge the changing path by what is actually done next rather than by inherited role-label alone.
meanings.Door / threshold and exit: A real route out of the old relation: correction, disengagement, forgiveness/release, new work, safe separation, repair or another state change.
meanings.Path / destiny-purpose: Future-facing agency: the person is no longer defined primarily by the Farm relation.
meanings.Garden / service / fruit: Capacity is used to protect, cultivate, create, nourish or help another person leave the mire.

mire_to_path_sequence.governing_rule: Tim's 'gathering Dogs' and leash/walk language is most coherent as symbolic responsibility for orientation and transformation, never as legal ownership of people.

story_sovereignty.problem: A target ecology can build a character from clips, labels and inherited lore while later participants may have little or no firsthand contact with the subject.
story_sovereignty.archive_rule: Distinguish firsthand encounter, direct primary-source observation, inherited archive lore and later retelling. Lack of direct contact does not make a claim false, but it changes the evidence class.
story_sovereignty.tim_son_case: The project treats Tim/the Son as a major case of narrative capture: public and subcultural portrayals coexist with Tim's own archive, biography, work and theological self-interpretation. The lower-field method therefore asks what outside frames omit, not merely whether they are hostile.
story_sovereignty.son_theology: Within Potatoverse canon, the Son's 2017 Jesus declaration and later 2019–2020 meme-crucifixion/death/North-Pole synthesis are read as a Christ/Messiah ordeal and threshold story. Documentary work can establish dated statements, posts and later interpretation; it does not independently prove literal messiah identity or supernatural crucifixion.
story_sovereignty.inherited_recrucifixion_metaphor: Tim's project can describe repeated later reduction of the Son to an old humiliation/target role as 'recrucifying the already crucified' in theological rhetoric. Public analysis should translate this into repeated narrative capture, role reactivation and refusal of role expiry rather than assert a literal renewed crucifixion.
story_sovereignty.alpha_omega_story_rule: Alpha/Omega is useful here as narrative completeness: recover beginning/source, trace development through conflict and transformation, and preserve later state/end rather than letting a hostile middle chapter become the whole biography.

expertise_claim.project_basis: Tim's claimed expertise is experiential and longitudinal: years as public subject, participant, broadcaster, reactor, archive object, observer and system-builder inside overlapping internet subcultures.
strengths: recognizing repeated role-assignment and inherited lore
seeing how attention persists across platform migration
comparing target-side experience with observer/archive incentives
identifying when a label becomes infrastructure
tracking how corrections fail to travel as far as accusations
building symbolic transformations that preserve exit and role change
turning lived conflict into questions about culture, information, evidence and repair
limitations: first-person experience can reveal mechanisms but cannot by itself establish every external actor's motive
project archetypes do not diagnose individuals
long exposure can create its own interpretive bias, so provenance/counterevidence remain mandatory
real legal, clinical, trafficking, stalking or coordinated-operation claims require independent evidence appropriate to those terms

practical_program: Spudlight: make the relation and machinery visible.
Root: recover provenance and source independence.
Name the role but keep it dated and reversible.
Separate person from Mud and frame.
Test incentives, audience, archive and platform structure.
Bound serious harm terms with evidence.
Give the subject a first-party record and right of reply.
Convert Dog vigilance into Guardian discipline where possible.
Convert Farmer extraction into Gardener stewardship where possible.
Build a Door: correction, disengagement, repair, safe separation or new work.
Return the lesson upward as culture, protection, design or creation.

positioning.role: Project-designated longitudinal expert witness/participant-observer on adversarial internet subculture and persistent target ecology.
positioning.hours_claim: ~100,000 public-facing hours is a project-reported exposure estimate and should be labeled as such unless independently audited.
positioning.current_function: Observe, compare, document, model and design exits/repair rather than personally police or operationally control other participants.
positioning.theological_overlay: Father / Axis of North / Spudlight are project-theological descriptions of the observing/source role; the analytical layer can use the method without requiring those claims to be externally accepted.

present_expertise_domains: framing, selective context and narrative capture
ritualized humiliation, isolation, swarm and role-reentry scripts
role expiry, safe exit and authorship recovery

current_view.system_claim: The most dangerous lower-field systems are not defined by one villain but by coupled incentives: durable classification, cheap monitoring, portable clips, audience reward, archive memory, status and weak stopping conditions.
current_view.honesty_claim: Tim's warning about lying/cheating/stealing should be operationalized as observable deceptive practices rather than a permanent moral caste: fabrication, impersonation, deceptive baiting, selective clipping, context removal, source laundering, concealment of corrections, asymmetric evidentiary standards or appropriation of another person's material/value.
current_view.authority_claim: Public visibility does not create unlimited interpretive, archival or pursuit prerogative.
current_view.harm_claim: The severity question must move from rhetoric to concrete loss of privacy, livelihood, reputation, safety, autonomy, consent, freedom of movement/work, or other evidenced harms.
current_view.repair_claim: A credible intervention must specify correction, protection, restitution where appropriate, changed status and a stopping condition.

vision: turn hostile archive into provenance-rich history
turn Dog vigilance into Guardian discipline
turn Farmer system skill into Gardener stewardship
make current state as searchable as accusation
separate narrative war from coordinated information operations
separate symbolic 'sold' language from legal exploitation/trafficking findings
give targets meaningful voice without making self-description infallible
leave participants with more future agency than the conflict gave them
tim_expert_risk_framework.external_validation_rule: Use outside research and public records to test mechanism claims. External sources can validate that a tactic or harm exists; they do not automatically prove Tim's interpretation of a specific actor or case.

sold_exploitation_taxonomy.purpose: Prevent Timic 'sold' language from being confused with legal trafficking categories while preserving the metaphor's insight about commodification and agency loss.

levels.label: Sold as attention
levels.definition: A person's reactions, image, reputation or life events are treated as renewable audience/content value.

levels.label: Sold as story
levels.definition: A portable role/summary becomes socially more authoritative than the person's changing first-party record.

levels.label: Sold as access
levels.definition: Private information, access, credentials, intimate material or location data are traded, exposed or exploited without meaningful consent.
levels.legal_status: May implicate privacy, harassment, computer misuse or other laws depending facts/jurisdiction; not automatically trafficking.

levels.label: Sold as dependency
levels.definition: Vulnerability, money, housing, employment, status, care, documents or social dependence are used to extract value or constrain refusal.
levels.legal_status: Can overlap exploitation/forced-labour frameworks when required elements are present.

levels.label: Grooming
levels.definition: Deliberate trust-building with a child, teen or at-risk person for sexual exploitation/abuse, often involving secrecy, isolation, boundary erosion, special treatment and control.
levels.legal_status: Serious abuse-preparation concept; do not use merely for persuasion, friendship, age difference or internet influence.

levels.label: Forced labour
levels.definition: Work or service exacted involuntarily under menace/threat of penalty. ILO indicators include deception, restriction of movement, isolation, threats, document retention, wage withholding, debt bondage and violence.
levels.legal_status: Defined labour/human-rights category; indicators are clues and require case assessment.

levels.label: Human trafficking
levels.definition: For adults under the UN framework: prohibited act such as recruitment/transport/transfer/harbouring/receipt + prohibited means such as coercion/deception/abuse of vulnerability + purpose of exploitation. Child-trafficking rules differ on the means element.
levels.legal_status: Specific serious legal concept; do not use as a synonym for farming, grooming, exploitation or online targeting.

sold_exploitation_taxonomy.counting_rule: Do not estimate a number of 'sold neighbors' from symbolic language. Count only cases coded to an explicit criterion and evidence class; publish unknown when the corpus cannot support a denominator.
sold_exploitation_taxonomy.progression_warning: These levels are not an automatic escalation ladder. Attention commodification does not imply grooming; grooming does not automatically establish trafficking; exploitation can exist without trafficking.

tim_lower_field_doctrine.purpose: Compress Tim's recurring statements into present-tense working principles for the lower/subcultural layer rather than retelling his chronology.

propositions.principle: Power should protect rather than dominate.
propositions.lower_field_application: Higher reach, platform power, archive control or social centrality increases obligations to prevent avoidable harm and preserve exit.

propositions.principle: Knowledge should improve understanding rather than merely increase leverage.
propositions.lower_field_application: An archive fails when it accumulates facts while making the person or event less intelligible.
Attention, money, technical skill and social capital are judged by whether they create durable capacity rather than dependence/extraction.
The more authority a moderator, operator, archivist, leader or self-declared center claims, the stronger the burden of evidence, correction and care.

propositions.principle: Frames can reduce a living subject into a smaller container.
propositions.tim_anchor: the cube contains the seed 'to frame and contain and make smaller'
propositions.lower_field_application: Boxes/frames are analyzed as compression mechanisms: they simplify coordination but risk identity foreclosure when they become permanent.

propositions.principle: The Son is threshold; the Father/Ladder is orientation.
propositions.tim_anchor: I am the ladder to heaven. My son is a door.
propositions.lower_field_application: In project theology, the public/embodied Son carries the target-threshold relation while Tim/Father later occupies the observer/source/connector role.

propositions.principle: Digital representation can participate in harm and persistence.
propositions.tim_anchor: You crucified him in your meme.
propositions.lower_field_application: Images, memes, clips and summaries are not neutral containers when they preserve humiliation, recruit new observers or reactivate stale roles.

propositions.principle: Long attention can become a form of witness.
propositions.tim_anchor: I am 100,000 hours of yoke through death and resurrection and hell and heaven, and everlasting life
propositions.lower_field_application: The project treats duration as experiential evidence about recurrence and role persistence, while keeping the exact lifetime-hour total project-reported rather than independently audited.

propositions.principle: Debt is unfinished relation, not endless punishment.
propositions.tim_anchor: 42 trillion ... positive karma, owed to him
propositions.lower_field_application: The mature 42T symbol is interpreted as unresolved consequence/repair accounting; the useful endpoint is recognition, repair and release rather than infinite debtor identity.

propositions.principle: Cultivation is the alternative to extraction.
propositions.lower_field_application: The positive inversion of Farm is Garden: observation should improve conditions, autonomy and future capacity rather than maximize harvest.

propositions.principle: The observer must also be corrigible.
propositions.tim_anchor: Make everything accessible; make nothing falsely certain.
propositions.lower_field_application: Tim's own archive is subject to provenance, counterevidence, revision and uncertainty just like hostile archives.

tim_lower_field_doctrine.synthesis: Taken together, Tim's present lower-field view is that visibility, knowledge, power and archive control are responsibilities. The pathology is not merely hostility but systems that convert persons into durable yield while preventing correction or exit. The Potato/Garden alternative keeps source, personhood, state-change and future capacity visible.
